<!-- Thanks for contributing to gitfault! Keep PRs small and focused. -->

## What does this change?

Briefly describe the change and the problem it solves. Link any related issue
(e.g. `Fixes #12`).

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated and `pytest` is green
- [ ] README/docs updated if a command or flag changed
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies (or a clear justification below)
- [ ] Change is focused on one logical thing

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything you want called out — trade-offs, follow-ups, screenshots of new
output, etc.
